motion.purpose: The one easing curve (--ease): arrow slides, underline shifts, row shift, top bar, photograph unveil.

motion.name: state-colour
motion.purpose: Colour, background and border changes on hover and focus (default easing).

motion.name: arrow-advance
motion.value: transform 0.35s to 0.45s var(--ease); translateX(5px) in buttons, translateX(8px) in service rows

motion.name: photo-unveil
motion.value: clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) to inset(0) over 1.3s, scale 1.1 to 1 over 1.7s, var(--ease)
motion.purpose: Photographs unveil top to bottom once, when 20% is in view (IntersectionObserver, rootMargin 0 0 -6% 0).

motion.name: topbar-in
motion.value: opacity and translateY(-14px) to 0 over 0.6s var(--ease)
motion.purpose: The top bar appears once scroll progress passes 0.955 of the entrance.

motion.name: scroll-cue
motion.value: @keyframes cue: scaleY 0 to 1 then fade, 2.4s var(--ease) infinite
motion.purpose: The 1px by 40px lit-brass line under 'Role para entrar'. The only looping animation.

motion.name: entrance-length
motion.purpose: Scroll distance of the arrival sequence.

motion.name: entrance-smoothing
motion.value: per frame: current += (target - current) * 0.16, snap below 0.0004
motion.purpose: Scroll progress is eased toward its target with requestAnimationFrame, not applied raw.

motion.name: entrance-phases
motion.value: approach 0 to 0.62; door opens 0.63 to 0.76 (rotateY up to 86deg); light floods 0.86 to 0.92; hero fades in 0.90 to 0.96; stage hidden after 0.93
motion.purpose: Progress thresholds written to --p, --s, --open, --in, --in2 on the stage.

motion.name: entrance-captions
motion.value: windows 0.10 to 0.27, 0.31 to 0.48, 0.53 to 0.675; fade and 14px rise
motion.purpose: Three captions pass during the approach.

motion.name: entrance-camera
motion.value: transform-origin 49.67% 58.71% (the door); door pinned at 62% of viewport height; photo width max(100vw, 102svh)
motion.purpose: The photograph scales from the door as a dolly; scale follows 1 / (1 - u) for a constant walking pace.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: html.still or no JS: stage removed, hero static as first screen, photographs shown, animations off, transitions 0.01ms

narrative.overview:
Every rule in this system is read off one photograph: the contemporary house the owner supplied (`public/assets/mansao.webp`), seen at dusk with its lights on. Its door and fascias give the coffee-black, its walls give the pale stone, its windows give the brass, and its architecture gives the straight lines and square corners. The site does not present a catalogue; the scroll walks the visitor up the path, the door swings open, warm light fills the frame, and the page is what is inside. This world replaced an earlier navy-and-gold version after the owner asked for a site that looked less like a template.

The personality is discreet, precise and warm. Large light type at tight tracking carries the voice; small uppercase labels at wide tracking do the naming; photography carries the atmosphere. Density is low: sections breathe at 88 to 200px of vertical padding, the 12-column grid is used asymmetrically, and hairlines do the dividing that boxes and cards would do elsewhere. Motion is one authored moment (the entrance) followed by stillness, with photographs unveiling as they enter view.

Two facts about the material must stay visible to anyone extending the system. Only the mansion photograph is the owner's; the five other photographs are Unsplash hotlinks used as illustrative placeholders. And two pieces of product data are unresolved and shown as visible `[a informar]` markers in the footer: the WhatsApp number and the CRECI registration.
keyCharacteristics: One typeface, Poppins, self-hosted; hierarchy comes from weight (300, 400, 500) and tracking, never from a second family.
One accent, brass, in two values: dark brass on light surfaces, lit-window brass on dark ones.
Square corners everywhere (radius 0) and no shadows; depth is tonal and photographic.
Hairlines (1px) structure lists, indices and steps; there are no card containers.
A 12-column grid used off-centre: text and images deliberately do not mirror each other.
One signature interaction, the scroll-driven arrival through the front door, with a complete static fallback.

rules.name: The Lit Window Rule
rules.body: Brass means light or action. It appears where something is lit (the windows, the cue, the progress line) or where something can be done (hover, underline, focus). It never fills a section, a panel or a block of text.

rules.name: The Two Brasses Rule
rules.body: `brass` on light, `brass-hi` on dark. Dark brass on coffee-black and lit brass on warm white both fail contrast; neither is used that way anywhere in the build.

rules.name: The Surface Focus Rule
rules.body: Each surface declares its own focus colour: `ink` on light surfaces, `brass-hi` on dark ones (2px outline, 3px offset). A new dark section must set it.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Poppins only. A second typeface is not available to this system; contrast comes from the jump between weight 300 at display size and weight 500 at label size.

rules.name: The Light and Tight Rule
rules.body: Anything above 1.75rem is weight 300 with negative tracking between -0.03em and -0.045em. Large type is never medium or bold.

rules.name: The Wide Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is reserved for 0.75 to 0.875rem text at weight 500 with at least +0.18em tracking. Sentences are never set in uppercase.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift. A panel separates from what is behind it by colour alone, as the warm-white form does on the veiled photograph.

rules.name: The Light Only Rule
rules.body: A gradient is admissible when it is light falling or shade over a photograph. A gradient used to decorate a flat surface is not part of this system.

dos: Do take every colour from the token set; a new surface is warm white, facade stone or coffee-black.
Do switch brass with the surface: `brass` on light, `brass-hi` on dark, and set the focus colour to match.
Do keep every corner square and every divider a 1px solid line.
Do set large type in Poppins 300 with negative tracking, and small naming text in Poppins 500 uppercase with at least +0.18em tracking.
Do place content on the 12-column grid off-centre, and collapse it to one column below 900px.
Do keep every tap target at 44px or taller and every paragraph under about 58ch.
Do label stock photography as illustrative until real material replaces it, and keep unresolved data (WhatsApp number, CRECI) as a visible marker rather than an invented value.
Do give any new motion a static equivalent under reduced motion, as the entrance and the photograph unveil both have.
donts: Don't add a second typeface, or set large type in a weight above 300.
Don't round a corner or add a box-shadow; this system has neither.
Don't use a gradient on a flat surface. Gradients here are light, or shade over a photograph.
Don't fill a section, panel or paragraph with brass, or introduce a second accent hue.
Don't wrap content in bordered or tinted cards; rows between hairlines and unframed photographs do that work.
Don't add a second authored scroll sequence; after the entrance the page is still except for photographs unveiling.
Don't present the mansion photograph or any stock image as a property for sale.
